failurePolicy: Keep every failed, timed-out, unknown, and inconclusive sample. Missing required conditions or raw evidence, or any applicable group/round below its unchanged criterion, is not passed; retest under the same frozen conditions and retest affected groups.

projectReuse: Existing QP10 quality-contract record and SP07/downstream task ownership.
Existing node:test runner and JSON/Markdown evidence convention.
tools/sp01-device-probe reports documented WeChat performance-entry capabilities but explicitly does not claim FPS.
reuseReview.selectedApproach: Register a versioned evidence intake using existing repository formats and tests; do not add a sampler or third-party runtime dependency at SP07.
reuseReview.adaptation: Metadata and test assertions only; product-specific instrumentation remains with the SP card that owns the real page and acceptance run.
reuseReview.licenseAndMaintenance: No third-party code or dependency is introduced by this registry.
reuseReview.measurementCapabilityLimit: The current WeChat API typings expose no FPS/per-frame entry. Existing Perfetto samples observe the WeChat AppBrand host layer but do not establish a distinct mini-program WebView frame stream or application attribution; neither is accepted as product QP05 evidence without further validation on the actual product scenario.

rollback.method: Revert only the QP10 registry, its test and plan references; no product or cloud state is changed.
